dialogues.jp: 声が聞こえる……。
dialogues.en: A voice rang through my head...
dialogues.text: A voice rang through my head...

dialogues.jp: 遠くのように聞こえて、近いようにも聞こえる。
dialogues.en: It felt like it was calling me from both afar, and up close.
dialogues.text: It felt like it was calling me from both afar, and up close.

dialogues.jp: 幼い子供たちが何処かで遊んでいる……。
dialogues.en: A gaggle of children were playing somewhere...
dialogues.text: A gaggle of children were playing somewhere...

dialogues.jp:
……どうやら俺は、また誰かの夢に入ってしまっ
たらしい。
dialogues.en: ...Looks like I've entered someone else's dream, again.
dialogues.text: ...Looks like I've entered someone else's dream, again.

dialogues.jp: 誰の、夢だ？
dialogues.en: Whose dream is this?
dialogues.text: Whose dream is this?

dialogues.jp:
そう思った途端、目の前に｛まり／鞠｝を手にした女の子
が見えた。
dialogues.en:
As if answering my thoughts, a vision of a young girl
appeared in front of me. She was holding a ball.
dialogues.text:
As if answering my thoughts, a vision of a young girl
appeared in front of me. She was holding a ball.

dialogues.jp:
少女は鞠をついて、遊んでいた。遊ぶ子供の声
は何人も聞こえるのに、少女の周りには誰もい
ない。
dialogues.en:
She was playing with the ball, by herself. I could hear
playful voices elsewhere, but no one was around her.
dialogues.text:
She was playing with the ball, by herself. I could hear
playful voices elsewhere, but no one was around her.

dialogues.jp: ただ一人、鞠をついている姿はなんか寂しい。
dialogues.en: She had to be lonely, playing with that ball alone...
dialogues.text: She had to be lonely, playing with that ball alone...

dialogues.jp: ……友達いないのか？
dialogues.en: ...Doesn't she have any friends?
dialogues.text: ...Doesn't she have any friends?

dialogues.jp: 不意に５人の少年が少女を取り囲んだ。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, five boys appeared, surrounding the girl.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, five boys appeared, surrounding the girl.

dialogues.jp:
５人の少年は、｛おび／怯｝える少女を取り囲み、威圧す
るようにジッと｛にら／睨｝みつけている。
dialogues.en:
The 5 of them stood, surrounding the frightened girl,
glaring at her menacingly.
dialogues.text:
The 5 of them stood, surrounding the frightened girl,
glaring at her menacingly.

dialogues.jp:
少女が逃げようとすると、その行く手を一人が
通せんぼするように｛ふさ／塞｝いだ。
dialogues.en:
The girl seemed to want to run away, but every escape route
was covered.
dialogues.text:
The girl seemed to want to run away, but every escape route
was covered.

dialogues.jp:
別の方向へ逃げようとするが、同じだった。逃
げられない少女は、ますます怯えていた。
dialogues.en:
No matter where she looked, all she saw were the boys. She
grew increasingly scared.
dialogues.text:
No matter where she looked, all she saw were the boys. She
grew increasingly scared.

dialogues.speaker: Boy 1
dialogues.jp:
「お前が変なこと言うから、本当になったじゃ
　ねえか」
dialogues.en: "All those weird things you said really came true."
dialogues.text: "All those weird things you said really came true."

dialogues.speaker: Boy 2
dialogues.jp: 「お前のせいで中西は犬にかまれたんだ」
dialogues.en: "Nakamura got bitten by a dog because of you!"
dialogues.text: "Nakamura got bitten by a dog because of you!"

dialogues.speaker: Nakamura
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、見ろよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, look at this!"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, look at this!"

dialogues.jp:
中西、と呼ばれた少年は、少女に足に巻いてあ
る包帯を見せる。
dialogues.en:
The boy, apparently named Nakamura, showed the girl his
bandaged leg.
dialogues.text:
The boy, apparently named Nakamura, showed the girl his
bandaged leg.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「でも、わたし、神様の声を聞いたんだもん
　……」
dialogues.en: "B, but, I only heard it from God..."
dialogues.text: "B, but, I only heard it from God..."

dialogues.jp: 怯えながらも、少女は少年たちに言葉を返す。
dialogues.en: She was trembling, but still tried to reply.
dialogues.text: She was trembling, but still tried to reply.

dialogues.jp:
それがいけなかったのかもしれない。少年たち
の目に、明らかに怒りの色が浮かんだ。
dialogues.en:
Maybe it wasn't the smartest move, though... there was clear
anger in the boys' eyes.
dialogues.text:
Maybe it wasn't the smartest move, though... there was clear
anger in the boys' eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Boy 1
dialogues.jp:
「またその話かよ。おまえ、でたらめ言ってん
　じゃないぞ」
dialogues.en: "That nonsense again. Don't talk rubbish!"
dialogues.text: "That nonsense again. Don't talk rubbish!"

dialogues.speaker: Boy 2
dialogues.jp: 「神様の声なんて、聞こえる訳ないだろ！」
dialogues.en: "Why would God want to talk to you!"
dialogues.text: "Why would God want to talk to you!"

dialogues.speaker: Boy 3
dialogues.jp: 「嘘つくのは、いい加減やめろよな」
dialogues.en: "Stop lying already."
dialogues.text: "Stop lying already."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「だって、聞こえたもん！」
dialogues.en: "B, but, I can!!"
dialogues.text: "B, but, I can!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nakamura
dialogues.jp: 「聞こえるわけねえよ。聞こえたら魔女だ」
dialogues.en: "Are you saying you're some witch?"
dialogues.text: "Are you saying you're some witch?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「聞こえたもん……」
dialogues.en: "I... can hear it..."
dialogues.text: "I... can hear it..."

dialogues.jp: 小さくなる声……。
dialogues.en: A barely audible whisper...
dialogues.text: A barely audible whisper...

dialogues.jp:
瞳を潤ませながら、少女は必死に答えようとす
る。
dialogues.en: Her eyes were watering, as she desperately pleaded.
dialogues.text: Her eyes were watering, as she desperately pleaded.

dialogues.jp: しかし、それははかない抵抗だった……。
dialogues.en: But it was futile resistance...
dialogues.text: But it was futile resistance...

dialogues.speaker: Boy 1
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、魔女だ」
dialogues.en: "She really is a witch."
dialogues.text: "She really is a witch."

dialogues.speaker: Boys
dialogues.jp: 「魔女、魔女、魔女――」
dialogues.en: "Witch, witch, witch~~"
dialogues.text: "Witch, witch, witch~~"

dialogues.jp: 少年達は一斉に魔女コールをする。
dialogues.en: The boys taunted her in perfect synchronization.
dialogues.text: The boys taunted her in perfect synchronization.

dialogues.jp: 少女は、鞠をを抱きしめて唇を噛んでいる。
dialogues.en:
The girl continued clutching the ball tightly. Her lips were
quivering.
dialogues.text:
The girl continued clutching the ball tightly. Her lips were
quivering.

dialogues.jp: 目には、今にも涙が溢れそうだ。
dialogues.en: Tears started to drop down the corners of her eyes.
dialogues.text: Tears started to drop down the corners of her eyes.

dialogues.jp:
なんてやつらだ。一人の女の子をよってたかっ
て……。
dialogues.en: The hell's up with these brats? Ganging up on a poor girl...
dialogues.text: The hell's up with these brats? Ganging up on a poor girl...

dialogues.jp:
夢を見るだけじゃなく、手を出すことも出来た
ら、すぐに止めに行くのに。
dialogues.en:
If only this wasn't a dream, I'd be putting a stop to this
nonsense immediately...
dialogues.text:
If only this wasn't a dream, I'd be putting a stop to this
nonsense immediately...

dialogues.speaker: Boy 6
dialogues.jp:
「おーい。そいつはいじめちゃだめだ！　いじ
　めると、悪いことが起こっちゃうぜ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you better stop bullying her! Bad things will happen!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, you better stop bullying her! Bad things will happen!"

dialogues.jp:
さらに別の仲間らしいのがやってきて、少女を
取り囲んでいる少年たちに言った。
dialogues.en:
Another boy, seemingly a friend of the group, called out to
the boys surrounding her.
dialogues.text:
Another boy, seemingly a friend of the group, called out to
the boys surrounding her.

dialogues.speaker: Boy 1
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ。悪いことって？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean, bad things?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean, bad things?"

dialogues.speaker: Boy 6
dialogues.jp:
「おかんが言ってたんだ。そいつは神社の子だ
　から、いじめるとバチが当たるって」
dialogues.en:
"Bad things! That girl's a child from the shrine, you'd be
punished by God if you bully her!"
dialogues.text:
"Bad things! That girl's a child from the shrine, you'd be
punished by God if you bully her!"

dialogues.speaker: Boy 1
dialogues.jp: 「え？　それ本当か？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Really?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Really?"

dialogues.jp: その瞬間。
dialogues.en: At that moment.
dialogues.text: At that moment.

dialogues.jp:
少年６人の１２の目が一斉に、沈痛な面持ちを
した女の子の顔に注がれる。
dialogues.en:
The 12 pairs of eyes belonging to the 6 boys locked on to
the still-cowering girl.
dialogues.text:
The 12 pairs of eyes belonging to the 6 boys locked on to
the still-cowering girl.

dialogues.jp: どこか、場の空気が変わったような気がした。
dialogues.en: The air seems to have changed...
dialogues.text: The air seems to have changed...

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （みんな、怖い……）
dialogues.en: "(Everyone's so... scary...)"
dialogues.text: "(Everyone's so... scary...)"

dialogues.jp:
女の子の思念が俺の脳にダイレクトに入ってく
る。やけに言葉が鮮明に聞こえるようになった。
dialogues.en:
The girl's thoughts were communicated directly to my brain.
Each word seemed clear as day to me.
dialogues.text:
The girl's thoughts were communicated directly to my brain.
Each word seemed clear as day to me.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （なんで、そんな目で見るの……？）
dialogues.en: "(Why are they looking at me like that...?)"
dialogues.text: "(Why are they looking at me like that...?)"

dialogues.jp:
少年達の目は今までと違っていた。例えて言え
ば、冷たいガラスのような目だ。
dialogues.en:
The boys' eyes had changed. Instead of firey or taunting,
they were cold and unnerving.
dialogues.text:
The boys' eyes had changed. Instead of firey or taunting,
they were cold and unnerving.

dialogues.jp:
何か得体の知れないものを見るような……。自
分とは異質なものに対する恐怖と嫌悪……。
dialogues.en:
Looking at my own gender behaving like that, made me
disgusted.
dialogues.text:
Looking at my own gender behaving like that, made me
disgusted.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （どうして、そんな目で見るの……？）
dialogues.en: "(Why do they stare like that...)"
dialogues.text: "(Why do they stare like that...)"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
（わたしは……ただ、神様の声が聞こえるだけ
　なのに）
dialogues.en: "(I can... only hear God's voice...)"
dialogues.text: "(I can... only hear God's voice...)"

dialogues.speaker: Boy 1
dialogues.jp: 「こいつには、もう関わるのやめようぜ」
dialogues.en: "We better stop bothering with her from now on."
dialogues.text: "We better stop bothering with her from now on."

dialogues.speaker: Boy 2
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そうだよな。俺たちまで何かあったら怖
　いからな」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah... I'm scared, something might happen to us!"
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah... I'm scared, something might happen to us!"

dialogues.speaker: Boy 3
dialogues.jp: 「魔女に呪われるなんて、冗談じゃないぜ」
dialogues.en: "The curse of a witch is scary!"
dialogues.text: "The curse of a witch is scary!"

dialogues.jp:
女の子は溢れる涙をぐっと堪えている。その耐
える姿は……すごく痛々しかった。
dialogues.en:
The girl silently stood there, doing her best to keep
herself from crying... it pained my heart.
dialogues.text:
The girl silently stood there, doing her best to keep
herself from crying... it pained my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （この人達の前では泣きたくない）
dialogues.en: "(I don't want to cry in front of them...)"
dialogues.text: "(I don't want to cry in front of them...)"

dialogues.jp: そんな女の子の気持ちが、俺に伝わってくる。
dialogues.en: The girls feelings were clearly communiacted to me.
dialogues.text: The girls feelings were clearly communiacted to me.

dialogues.speaker: Boy 1
dialogues.jp: 「行こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Boys
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 少年達は、女の子の前を去っていった。
dialogues.en: The boys then walked away from her.
dialogues.text: The boys then walked away from her.

dialogues.jp:
女の子は、鞠をもう一度、力いっぱい抱きしめ
る。
dialogues.en: The girl, once again, started clutching the ball tightly.
dialogues.text: The girl, once again, started clutching the ball tightly.

dialogues.jp: 女の子の瞳からは、一筋の涙がこぼれ落ちた。
dialogues.en: A line of liquid dripped down her eyes, and off her cheek.
dialogues.text: A line of liquid dripped down her eyes, and off her cheek.

dialogues.jp: 鞠に当たり、小さな染みになる。
dialogues.en: it struck the ball, leaving a wet spot.
dialogues.text: it struck the ball, leaving a wet spot.

dialogues.jp:
堪えて、堪えて……、やっと流すことのできた
悲しい涙だった……。
dialogues.en:
She endured, and endured.... until finally, one sad tear
escaped...
dialogues.text:
She endured, and endured.... until finally, one sad tear
escaped...

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （……わたしは、魔女なのかな？）

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （みんなに不幸を運んじゃうのかな……）
dialogues.en: "(I do give everyone bad luck...)"
dialogues.text: "(I do give everyone bad luck...)"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （わたしは、ダメな子なのかな……）
dialogues.en: "(I'm really... a bad girl...)"
dialogues.text: "(I'm really... a bad girl...)"

dialogues.jp:
女の子の瞳から、次から次へとドロップのよう
な涙の雫が溢れ落ちる。
dialogues.en:
The girl's tears started streaming, one-by-one, like a
waterfall.
dialogues.text:
The girl's tears started streaming, one-by-one, like a
waterfall.

dialogues.jp:
あまりにもかわいそうで、夢でなければ……抱
きしめているところだ。
dialogues.en:
What a sad dream this is... I wanted to hug her, and tell
her it was just a dream.
dialogues.text:
What a sad dream this is... I wanted to hug her, and tell
her it was just a dream.

dialogues.jp: しかし、今の俺には何もできない。
dialogues.en: But, I simply can't do anything as I am.
dialogues.text: But, I simply can't do anything as I am.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.en: "...sniff... hic..."
dialogues.text: "...sniff... hic..."

dialogues.jp: 女の子は泣きながら、走り去っていった。
dialogues.en: The girl eventually ran off, still crying.
dialogues.text: The girl eventually ran off, still crying.

dialogues.jp: 女の子がいたのは、環の住んでいる神社だった。
dialogues.en: The scene changed, to the shrine where Tamaki stays in.
dialogues.text: The scene changed, to the shrine where Tamaki stays in.

dialogues.jp:
そして、あの御神木の｛まき／槙｝の木の下にたどり着く
と、
dialogues.en: She eventually reached the tree, and...
dialogues.text: She eventually reached the tree, and...

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「うあぁぁぁ……あぁぁ……！」
dialogues.en: "Uwaahhh.... wahhhhhhh...!"
dialogues.text: "Uwaahhh.... wahhhhhhh...!"

dialogues.jp:
堪えきれなくなった想いが、声となって、女の
子の口からほとばしり出た。
dialogues.en:
All her pent up emotions were released from her mouth and
eyes.
dialogues.text:
All her pent up emotions were released from her mouth and
eyes.

dialogues.jp: とめどなく頬を伝う涙。
dialogues.en: The tears seemed to flow endlessly down.
dialogues.text: The tears seemed to flow endlessly down.

dialogues.jp: 泣き声は、神社の境内に空しく響き渡る。
dialogues.en: Her wails resounded around the deserted shrine grounds.
dialogues.text: Her wails resounded around the deserted shrine grounds.

dialogues.jp: 夢であることが、こんなに切ないなんてな。
dialogues.en: I didn't know dreams could be as painful as this.
dialogues.text: I didn't know dreams could be as painful as this.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、こんな小さな子はあの辺りじゃ見たこ
とがないな。
dialogues.en: Besides this girl, I couldn't see anything else.
dialogues.text: Besides this girl, I couldn't see anything else.

dialogues.jp:
誰かの想像の夢なのか、もしくは小さな頃の思
い出なのか……。
dialogues.en:
Rather than some dream brought up from imagination, this
seems like a childhood memory...
dialogues.text:
Rather than some dream brought up from imagination, this
seems like a childhood memory...

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「どうして泣いてるの？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you crying?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you crying?"

dialogues.jp:
不意に声が聞こえ、一瞬、泣き止み、辺りをキョ
ロキョロと見渡す。
dialogues.en:
The sudden voice caused her tears to run dry, and she looked
around frantically.
dialogues.text:
The sudden voice caused her tears to run dry, and she looked
around frantically.

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「こっち、こっち。上だよ、上」
dialogues.en: "I'm up here, up!"
dialogues.text: "I'm up here, up!"

dialogues.jp:
女の子が声のした方を見上げると、顔は良く見
えないが、男の子が槙の木の枝に腰掛けている
のが見えた。
dialogues.en:
I looked up with the girl. I didn't have a clear view, but
made out the sihoulette of a boy sitting on a branch.
dialogues.text:
I looked up with the girl. I didn't have a clear view, but
made out the sihoulette of a boy sitting on a branch.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「だあれ？」
dialogues.en: "Who's that?"
dialogues.text: "Who's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「登ってくれば、わかるよ」
dialogues.en: "If you can climb up here, you'd find out."
dialogues.text: "If you can climb up here, you'd find out."

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「スカートだもん。登れないよ」
dialogues.en: "...I'm wearing a skirt. I can't climb up!"
dialogues.text: "...I'm wearing a skirt. I can't climb up!"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「そんなの気にするなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about that."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about that."

dialogues.jp:
女の子は辺りに誰もいないのを確認し、槙の木
をよじ登り始める。
dialogues.en:
The girl looked around first, to make sure no one was
watching. She then began her slow ascent.
dialogues.text:
The girl looked around first, to make sure no one was
watching. She then began her slow ascent.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「……っ、よいしょっ」

小さな手と足をいっぱい広げて、一生懸命に登
る。
dialogues.en:
Her little hands and legs stretched with all their might, as
she climbed as hard as she could.
dialogues.text:
Her little hands and legs stretched with all their might, as
she climbed as hard as she could.

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「ほら。つかまれよ」
dialogues.en: "There, I have you."
dialogues.text: "There, I have you."

dialogues.jp:
男の子は女の子の手をつかんで、枝へと引っ張
りあげた。
dialogues.en:
The boy grabbed onto the girl's hand, and helped her up to
the branch he was sitting on.
dialogues.text:
The boy grabbed onto the girl's hand, and helped her up to
the branch he was sitting on.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ありがとう……」
dialogues.en: "T, thank you..."
dialogues.text: "T, thank you..."

dialogues.jp: しかし、男の子の顔は逆光になって見えない。
dialogues.en:
The boy's face was still hidden to me, thanks to the glare
from the sun behind him.
dialogues.text:
The boy's face was still hidden to me, thanks to the glare
from the sun behind him.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「うわあ。高いね」
dialogues.en: "Wow, we're so high up!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, we're so high up!"

dialogues.jp:
女の子は自分がさっきまでいた場所を見下ろし
ながら、目を丸くしていた。
dialogues.en: Looking at where she started from, her eyes grew wide.
dialogues.text: Looking at where she started from, her eyes grew wide.

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp:
「泣いてばかりいないで、これ食ってさ、元気
　出せよ」
dialogues.en: "You cried so much... have this, it should cheer you up."
dialogues.text: "You cried so much... have this, it should cheer you up."

dialogues.jp:
男の子が差し出した手のひらには、いつの間に
か、一つの栗饅頭が乗っていた。
dialogues.en:
The boy offered his hand to the girl, revealing a chestnut
manjuu on it. When did it get there...?
dialogues.text:
The boy offered his hand to the girl, revealing a chestnut
manjuu on it. When did it get there...?

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「わあ、栗饅頭だ。どうしたの、これ？」
dialogues.en: "Wah, a chestnut manjuu! Why's this here?"
dialogues.text: "Wah, a chestnut manjuu! Why's this here?"

dialogues.jp: 男の子は、黙って栗饅頭を女の子に渡す。
dialogues.en: The boy silently gave the chestnut manjuu to the girl.
dialogues.text: The boy silently gave the chestnut manjuu to the girl.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「もらってもいいの？」
dialogues.en: "Is it really okay for me to eat this?"
dialogues.text: "Is it really okay for me to eat this?"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「その為に出したんだよ」
dialogues.en: "That's why I made it."
dialogues.text: "That's why I made it."

dialogues.jp: 女の子は栗饅頭を一口かじる。
dialogues.en: The girl put the whole chestnut manjuu in her mouth.
dialogues.text: The girl put the whole chestnut manjuu in her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「おいしい！」
dialogues.en: "It's yummy!"
dialogues.text: "It's yummy!"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「よかった」
dialogues.en: "That's good."
dialogues.text: "That's good."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ほんと、おいしい。ウフフ……」
dialogues.en: "Hehe, it really is..."
dialogues.text: "Hehe, it really is..."

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「やっと笑ったな」
dialogues.en: "You finally smiled."
dialogues.text: "You finally smiled."

dialogues.jp:
女の子がハッとする。ごく自然に笑っていた自
分に驚くみたいに。
dialogues.en:
The girl put a hand over her mouth, as if trying to hide it.
She seemed genuinely shocked that she was smiling...
dialogues.text:
The girl put a hand over her mouth, as if trying to hide it.
She seemed genuinely shocked that she was smiling...

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「あなたは、わたしのことをいじめないの？」
dialogues.en: "You... aren't going to bully me?"
dialogues.text: "You... aren't going to bully me?"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「なんで？」
dialogues.en: "Why would I?"
dialogues.text: "Why would I?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
「だって、みんな、わたしのこと魔女って言う
　もん」
dialogues.en: "Because everyone calls me a witch..."
dialogues.text: "Because everyone calls me a witch..."

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「魔女なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you a witch?"
dialogues.text: "Are you a witch?"

dialogues.jp: 女の子は首を大きく横に振る。
dialogues.en: The girl shook her head rapidly.
dialogues.text: The girl shook her head rapidly.

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp:
「魔女は｛ほうき／箒｝に乗ってるだろ？　でもキミは乗っ
　てないじゃん」
dialogues.en: "Witches ride on brooms, right? You don't have one."
dialogues.text: "Witches ride on brooms, right? You don't have one."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「うん」

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp:
「それに、魔女って魔法で人を幸せにするんだ
　ぞ。本当はすごいんだからな」
dialogues.en:
"Besides, witches who use their magic to help people are
really awesome!"
dialogues.text:
"Besides, witches who use their magic to help people are
really awesome!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「そうなの？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp:
「そうだよ。だから、魔女って言われたら、喜
　ばなくちゃ」
dialogues.en: "Really. So you should be happy to be called a witch!"
dialogues.text: "Really. So you should be happy to be called a witch!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ふぅん、そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I understand!"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I understand!"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「そうさ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, you do."
dialogues.text: "Yes, you do."

dialogues.jp: 女の子の顔に、ホッとしたような笑みが広がる。
dialogues.en: The girl's face relaxed into a relieved smile.
dialogues.text: The girl's face relaxed into a relieved smile.

dialogues.jp:
二人は、いつしか地面に下りていた。それでも
男の子の顔は見えない。
dialogues.en:
The two eventually dropped to the ground. But the boy's face
was still hidden.
dialogues.text:
The two eventually dropped to the ground. But the boy's face
was still hidden.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （何だろう、この気持ち……）
dialogues.en: "(What is this feeling...)"
dialogues.text: "(What is this feeling...)"

dialogues.jp: また、女の子の気持ちが聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: The girl's thoughts flowed into me once again.
dialogues.text: The girl's thoughts flowed into me once again.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
（この子……わたしのこと……変な目で見てな
　い……）
dialogues.en: "(This boy... he isn't looking at me weirdly...)"
dialogues.text: "(This boy... he isn't looking at me weirdly...)"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （すごくあったかい……）
dialogues.en: "(It feels so warm...)"
dialogues.text: "(It feels so warm...)"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp:
（不思議だな……。それに、神様の声が聞こえ
　ないや）
dialogues.en: "(It's so weird... and I can't hear God's voice now...)"
dialogues.text: "(It's so weird... and I can't hear God's voice now...)"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: （こんなの、初めて……）
dialogues.en: "(This is the first time...)"
dialogues.text: "(This is the first time...)"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、わたしと友達になってくれない？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, will you be my friend?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, will you be my friend?"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp:
「友達？　そういうのは、お願いしてなるもん
　じゃないよ」
dialogues.en: "Friends? You don't have to ask me that."
dialogues.text: "Friends? You don't have to ask me that."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.en: "...You don't wanna?"
dialogues.text: "...You don't wanna?"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことはない」
dialogues.en: "Not at all."
dialogues.text: "Not at all."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、お嫁さんにして」
dialogues.en: "Then, I want to be your wife!"
dialogues.text: "Then, I want to be your wife!"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「お嫁さん？」
dialogues.en: "My... wife?"
dialogues.text: "My... wife?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.en: "No?"
dialogues.text: "No?"

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「嫌じゃないけど……」
dialogues.en: "It's not that..."
dialogues.text: "It's not that..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、約束。はい」
dialogues.en: "Then, promise me!"
dialogues.text: "Then, promise me!"

dialogues.jp:
女の子が小指を差し出す。それが意味するのは、
もちろん一つだろう。
dialogues.en:
The girl stuck out her pinky. That obviously meant only one
thing.
dialogues.text:
The girl stuck out her pinky. That obviously meant only one
thing.

dialogues.jp: 男の子が黙って、小指を絡める。
dialogues.en: The boy silently stuck out his, as well.
dialogues.text: The boy silently stuck out his, as well.

dialogues.speaker: Girl
dialogues.jp: 「ゆ〜びき〜りげ〜んまん……♪」
dialogues.en: "Fingers linked?"
dialogues.text: "Fingers linked?"

dialogues.jp:
次の瞬間、目の前で光が弾けて、真っ白になっ
た。
dialogues.en: Right after, my vision exploded into sheer white.
dialogues.text: Right after, my vision exploded into sheer white.

dialogues.jp: 白い部屋の中……。
dialogues.en: A white room...
dialogues.text: A white room...

dialogues.jp:
さっきとは違う女の子が、ぽつんと一人、椅子
に腰掛けている。
dialogues.en:
A girl, seemingly different from the last one, was sitting
in a chair.
dialogues.text:
A girl, seemingly different from the last one, was sitting
in a chair.

dialogues.jp:
さっきの子供じゃない。けれど、それほど歳が
離れているわけではなさそうだ。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't the girl from the last dream... but the only
difference between them seemed to be age.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't the girl from the last dream... but the only
difference between them seemed to be age.

dialogues.jp:
そして、その女の子は環に似ていた。おそらく
環本人に、違いない。
dialogues.en: And she looks quite like Tamaki... it probably is her.
dialogues.text: And she looks quite like Tamaki... it probably is her.

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、さっきの女の子も心なしか環に似
ていたような気がする。
dialogues.en:
...Now that I think about it, the previous girl looked like
a young Tamaki too...
dialogues.text:
...Now that I think about it, the previous girl looked like
a young Tamaki too...

dialogues.jp:
じゃあ、さっきから俺が見させられている夢は、
環の夢──なのか？
dialogues.en: So, the dream I saw just now... that was Tamaki's dream?
dialogues.text: So, the dream I saw just now... that was Tamaki's dream?

dialogues.jp:
白い部屋──白い光の中に、環が吸い込まれて
いく。
dialogues.en:
In the white room--in the middle of the whiteness, Tamaki
inhaled and exhaled deeply.
dialogues.text:
In the white room--in the middle of the whiteness, Tamaki
inhaled and exhaled deeply.

dialogues.jp:
何処からか、声が聞こえてくる。それは環の耳
に残っている声のようだった。
dialogues.en:
So many voices poured from the whiteness. They were the
words that Tamaki had heard around her.
dialogues.text:
So many voices poured from the whiteness. They were the
words that Tamaki had heard around her.

dialogues.speaker: Classmate
dialogues.jp:
「ねえ、胡ノ宮さんって、未来が見えるんで
　しょ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Konomiya-san can see the future?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Konomiya-san can see the future?"

dialogues.speaker: Classmate
dialogues.jp: 「すごいわね。私の未来も見てくれない？」
dialogues.en: "That's amazing. Can you see my future?"
dialogues.text: "That's amazing. Can you see my future?"

dialogues.speaker: Classmate
dialogues.jp: 「胡ノ宮さん、一緒にお昼ご飯食べよう」
dialogues.en: "Konomiya-san, let's have lunch together!"
dialogues.text: "Konomiya-san, let's have lunch together!"

dialogues.speaker: Classmate
dialogues.jp:
「私達、友達よね。お願い、私と彼がどうなる
　か教えて」
dialogues.en:
"We're friends, right? Please tell me how my boyfriend and I
will end up!"
dialogues.text:
"We're friends, right? Please tell me how my boyfriend and I
will end up!"

dialogues.speaker: Classmate
dialogues.jp: 「え？　私が事故に遭う？　冗談じゃないわよ」
dialogues.en: "Eh? I'd meet with an accident? Don't joke around!"
dialogues.text: "Eh? I'd meet with an accident? Don't joke around!"

dialogues.speaker: Classmate
dialogues.jp:
「もっとまともな未来だと思ってた……。がっ
　かり……」
dialogues.en:
"I thought you'd be more serious about it... how
disappointing."
dialogues.text:
"I thought you'd be more serious about it... how
disappointing."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: （みんな、なんて勝手なんだろう……）
dialogues.en: "(Everyone only thinks about themselves...)"
dialogues.text: "(Everyone only thinks about themselves...)"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: （……人の未来なんて知りたくないのに……）
dialogues.en: "(...I don't want to see other people's futures...)"
dialogues.text: "(...I don't want to see other people's futures...)"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: （人の未来なんて、知らなければ……）
dialogues.en: "(Because if I see them...)"
dialogues.text: "(Because if I see them...)"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: （でも……見えてしまう……）
dialogues.en: "(But... no matter what I do, I always see it...)"
dialogues.text: "(But... no matter what I do, I always see it...)"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: （せめて、少しでもコントロールできれば……）
dialogues.en: "(If only I could control it, even a little...)"
dialogues.text: "(If only I could control it, even a little...)"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
（巫女の厳しい修行に耐えれば、きっと、神様
　が守ってくれる……）
dialogues.en:
"(But this is the fate of all Miko... I must endure, and
surely God will protect me...)"
dialogues.text:
"(But this is the fate of all Miko... I must endure, and
surely God will protect me...)"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: （きっと……）
dialogues.en: "(Surely...)"
dialogues.text: "(Surely...)"

dialogues.jp: 目が、覚めた。
dialogues.en: My eyes opened.
dialogues.text: My eyes opened.

dialogues.jp:
夢から覚めた後も、まだ環の思念が残っている
ような気がして、呆然としてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Even after the dream ended, I could feel Tamaki's thoughts
within me.
dialogues.text:
Even after the dream ended, I could feel Tamaki's thoughts
within me.

dialogues.jp: あの、木の上の少年……。
dialogues.en: That boy, at the treetop...
dialogues.text: That boy, at the treetop...

dialogues.jp: あれは、俺だ。
dialogues.en: It has to be me.
dialogues.text: It has to be me.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、槙の木の上で、あいつに会ってたんだ。
dialogues.en: It was on top of that tree, that I met... her.
dialogues.text: It was on top of that tree, that I met... her.

dialogues.jp:
あんな出来事があったのに、どうして俺は今ま
で環のことを忘れていたんだろう。
dialogues.en:
Considering what I did there though, how could I forget
about her?
dialogues.text:
Considering what I did there though, how could I forget
about her?

dialogues.jp:
まるで夢でも見ているような気分だ。（実際に
夢に見ただけなのだが）
dialogues.en:
It felt like I was watching a dream. (Which I was really
doing anyway)
dialogues.text:
It felt like I was watching a dream. (Which I was really
doing anyway)

dialogues.jp: あれは、本当に俺なのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Was that really me?
dialogues.text: Was that really me?

dialogues.jp: どうして、あの時の記憶がないのだろう。
dialogues.en: Why don't I have any memories of that event?
dialogues.text: Why don't I have any memories of that event?

dialogues.jp:
思い出したのか、環の夢を見せられて、そんな
出来事があったように思っているだけなのか。
dialogues.en:
My inability to remember it, and Tamaki's dream, made the
incident circle around my head even more.
dialogues.text:
My inability to remember it, and Tamaki's dream, made the
incident circle around my head even more.

dialogues.en: "...It hurts..."
dialogues.text: "...It hurts..."

dialogues.jp: 思い出そうとすると、頭がずきんと痛んだ。
dialogues.en: Thinking too hard about it was making my head hurt.
dialogues.text: Thinking too hard about it was making my head hurt.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、その記憶の前後も、ぼやけているよ
うで、正確にいつ頃の出来事なのかが思い出せ
ない。
dialogues.en:
It's never easy to recall memories from young... that may be
the reason why I don't remember it.
dialogues.text:
It's never easy to recall memories from young... that may be
the reason why I don't remember it.

dialogues.jp:
ただ……、あの時に作った栗饅頭の感触と、受
け取った環の少し冷たい手……。それだけは、
なんとなく、よみがえってきた気がした。
dialogues.en:
Yet... the feeling of creating that chestnut manjuu, and the
touch of her hand, seemed to linger inside...
dialogues.text:
Yet... the feeling of creating that chestnut manjuu, and the
touch of her hand, seemed to linger inside...

dialogues.jp:
なぜ、それが今まで思い出せなかったのか……、
いや、記憶がなかったのかわからないけれど、
あれが俺と環が｛いいなずけ／許嫁｝である理由だろうか。
dialogues.en:
Why can't I remember it... regardless, that's undoubtedly
the reason for our engagement.
dialogues.text:
Why can't I remember it... regardless, that's undoubtedly
the reason for our engagement.

dialogues.jp:
子どもの約束といえば、ちょっとつたないけれ
ど、それでもケッコンの約束には間違いない。
dialogues.en:
It may have been merely a promise to marry, made as a child,
but it was still one.
dialogues.text:
It may have been merely a promise to marry, made as a child,
but it was still one.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、環もそれを忘れているというのは、お
かしな話だし、『深い絆』というには、ちょっ
とお粗末すぎるのではないか。
dialogues.en:
But that doesn't explain why she doesn't remember it either,
or the "deep bond" that we share.
dialogues.text:
But that doesn't explain why she doesn't remember it either,
or the "deep bond" that we share.

dialogues.jp:
とはいえ、さっきの夢も俺の記憶が｛あいまい／曖昧｝である
以上、本当の出来事かどうかわからないのだけ
れど。
dialogues.en:
So basically, thanks to the ambiguity of dreams, many things
still remain unknown.
dialogues.text:
So basically, thanks to the ambiguity of dreams, many things
still remain unknown.

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、環にあんな過去があったなんて
な……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki had that kind of past, huh...
dialogues.text: Tamaki had that kind of past, huh...

dialogues.jp:
環があまり人と打ち解けないのは、人の未来が
見えてしまうからだ。
dialogues.en:
She was never one to throw off her reservedness in the first
place. And with the ability to see people's futures...
dialogues.text:
She was never one to throw off her reservedness in the first
place. And with the ability to see people's futures...

dialogues.jp:
その能力を知ってしまった人は、環を好奇の目
で見て、自分の未来に対する欲望を、環にぶつ
けてくる。
dialogues.en:
People who knew that, were curious about their own futures,
and wanted Tamaki to see theirs.
dialogues.text:
People who knew that, were curious about their own futures,
and wanted Tamaki to see theirs.

dialogues.jp: 環に求めているのは、ただそれだけだ。
dialogues.en: It was simply begging Tamaki for a favour, nothing more.
dialogues.text: It was simply begging Tamaki for a favour, nothing more.

dialogues.jp: 友達としてではなく、未来が見える人として。
dialogues.en:
They weren't friends. Just people trying to peek into the
fourth dimension.
dialogues.text:
They weren't friends. Just people trying to peek into the
fourth dimension.

dialogues.jp:
環も、見えてしまったら、聞かれたら、伝えな
くてはいけないと思うのだろう。
dialogues.en:
And when Tamaki did see the future, hear God's word about
it, would she have wanted to say it either?
dialogues.text:
And when Tamaki did see the future, hear God's word about
it, would she have wanted to say it either?

dialogues.jp: 常に良い未来ならいいが、違う未来もある。
dialogues.en: It's fine if it's a good future, but if it's a bad one...
dialogues.text: It's fine if it's a good future, but if it's a bad one...

dialogues.jp:
そんな時、相手に自分の能力を知られないよう
に、不幸を回避する方法。
dialogues.en:
It seems she'd been using her power to save other people
from misfortune, while still hiding it...
dialogues.text:
It seems she'd been using her power to save other people
from misfortune, while still hiding it...

dialogues.jp: 学園で噂になったような、突拍子もない行動。
dialogues.en:
The school'd been gabbing about it for ages, about her weird
behaviour.
dialogues.text:
The school'd been gabbing about it for ages, about her weird
behaviour.

dialogues.jp:
予知能力を知られるより、変人扱いをされた方
がいい、という選択なのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Whether to have everyone know about her clairvoyancy, or
think of her as a weirdo...
dialogues.text:
Whether to have everyone know about her clairvoyancy, or
think of her as a weirdo...

dialogues.jp: そんなに、悩むなよ。
dialogues.en: Don't worry yourself so much about it.
dialogues.text: Don't worry yourself so much about it.

dialogues.jp:
そう声をかけてやりたかった。そんな言葉が慰
めにならないと解っていても。
dialogues.en:
I found myself saying that unconsciously. I wanted to say
those words to her, to comfort her.
dialogues.text:
I found myself saying that unconsciously. I wanted to say
those words to her, to comfort her.

dialogues.jp: やりきれない気持ちになって、ベッドを出た。
dialogues.en:
Carrying the weight of nearly unbearable feelings, I finally
got out of bed.
dialogues.text:
Carrying the weight of nearly unbearable feelings, I finally
got out of bed.

dialogues.jp:
昨日で、学校はとりあえず終わったはずなのに、
どうやら俺は今日学校に行かなければならない
らしい。
dialogues.en:
School more or less ended yesterday, so there's no reason
for me to go there.
dialogues.text:
School more or less ended yesterday, so there's no reason
for me to go there.

dialogues.jp:
昨日、帰ろうとした直前に、暦先生にとっ掴ま
り、ちょっとだけ先生の手伝いをさせられるこ
とになった。
dialogues.en:
Except for my encounter with Koyomi-sensei yesterday, when
she strongarmed me into helping her with her "projects".
dialogues.text:
Except for my encounter with Koyomi-sensei yesterday, when
she strongarmed me into helping her with her "projects".

dialogues.jp:
なぜ、俺なのかというと、俺が『誠実』で『従
順』で『頼りになる』からだそうだ。
dialogues.en:
Why did I accept? Because I'm "sincere", "obedient", and
"helpful", of course.
dialogues.text:
Why did I accept? Because I'm "sincere", "obedient", and
"helpful", of course.

dialogues.jp: ──どこがだよ！
dialogues.en: --Haha, who am I kidding.
dialogues.text: --Haha, who am I kidding.

dialogues.jp:
学校に着くと、環が来るのが見えた。どうやら、
彼女も何かの理由で学校に来ているということ
か。
dialogues.en:
As I arrived at school, I saw the figure of Tamaki. It
seemed she had some reason to come to school too.
dialogues.text:
As I arrived at school, I saw the figure of Tamaki. It
seemed she had some reason to come to school too.

dialogues.jp:
まだ、どんな風に声をかけたらいいのか、決め
てないのに。
dialogues.en:
With the dream still replaying constantly in my head, I
didn't know how I should greet her...
dialogues.text:
With the dream still replaying constantly in my head, I
didn't know how I should greet her...

dialogues.jp:
悩んでると、会ったりするんだよな……。偶然
にも出来すぎてるぞ。
dialogues.en:
As I wracked my poor brain trying to come up with an answer,
my legs kept moving to the point where she noticed me
herself.
dialogues.text:
As I wracked my poor brain trying to come up with an answer,
my legs kept moving to the point where she noticed me
herself.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます。朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.jp: 環は、何事もなかったように話しかけてくる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki greeted me with her usual mix of calmness and
innocence.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki greeted me with her usual mix of calmness and
innocence.

dialogues.jp: ま、当たり前か。
dialogues.en: Well, of course she would.
dialogues.text: Well, of course she would.

dialogues.jp:
環は予知能力はあっても、俺がどんな能力を持っ
ているのかまでは分からないんだろう。
dialogues.en:
She may be able to see the future, but she can't see the
powers I have...
dialogues.text:
She may be able to see the future, but she can't see the
powers I have...

dialogues.jp: 逆に、知ったら……どう思うだろう？
dialogues.en:
If she knew, and she knew that I knew... what would she
think?
dialogues.text:
If she knew, and she knew that I knew... what would she
think?

dialogues.jp: 「おっす。おはよさん」
dialogues.en: "Yo, mornin'."
dialogues.text: "Yo, mornin'."

dialogues.jp: 努めて普通に振舞う。
dialogues.en:
I forced myself to return her greeting as normally as
possible.
dialogues.text:
I forced myself to return her greeting as normally as
possible.

dialogues.jp:
が、やはり今日の夢のことが気になって仕方が
ない。
dialogues.en: I really can't forget about the dream, though.
dialogues.text: I really can't forget about the dream, though.

dialogues.jp: 尋ねるべきなんだろうが……。
dialogues.en: But how should I ask about it...
dialogues.text: But how should I ask about it...

dialogues.jp: こういう話は、タイミングが大切だからな。
dialogues.en:
Timing is of utmost importance on sensitive matters like
this...
dialogues.text:
Timing is of utmost importance on sensitive matters like
this...

dialogues.jp:
いや、うだうだ悩むより、単刀直入に聞いた方
がいい。
dialogues.en:
I should just cut the useless crap and get to the heart of
the matter...
dialogues.text:
I should just cut the useless crap and get to the heart of
the matter...

dialogues.jp: 『急いては事を仕損じる』だ。
dialogues.en: Act first, get in trouble later, as they say.
dialogues.text: Act first, get in trouble later, as they say.

dialogues.jp: いや違った。えっと……そうじゃなくて……。
dialogues.en: ...Wait, that's not how it goes...hm.
dialogues.text: ...Wait, that's not how it goes...hm.

dialogues.jp: とにかく『当たって砕けろ』だ。
dialogues.en: In any case, the direct approach seems the best.
dialogues.text: In any case, the direct approach seems the best.

dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、環……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: 俺が話を切り出そうとしたその瞬間……。
dialogues.en: Just as I was about to start some conversation...
dialogues.text: Just as I was about to start some conversation...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-senpai!!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-senpai!!"

dialogues.jp: 美春が見ていたかのように声をかけてくる。
dialogues.en:
Miharu made her presence known, with the sound of her shrill
voice.
dialogues.text:
Miharu made her presence known, with the sound of her shrill
voice.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、わんこ」
dialogues.en: "What is it, puppy."
dialogues.text: "What is it, puppy."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もう。わんこじゃありませんよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Geez, I'm not a puppy!"
dialogues.text: "Geez, I'm not a puppy!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、ブルドックか？」
dialogues.en: "A bulldog, then?"
dialogues.text: "A bulldog, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ひどーい。朝倉先輩。それもわんこです」
dialogues.en: "That's meaaaan, Asakura-senpai! And that's still a puppy!"
dialogues.text: "That's meaaaan, Asakura-senpai! And that's still a puppy!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "My mistake."
dialogues.text: "My mistake."

dialogues.jp:
本当は、こんなギャグを美春と言っている場合
では無いのだが……。
dialogues.en: This really isn't the time to be cracking jokes like this...
dialogues.text: This really isn't the time to be cracking jokes like this...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、お隣の方はもしや……」
dialogues.en: "Senpai, next to you, she's..."
dialogues.text: "Senpai, next to you, she's..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「胡ノ宮環と申します」
dialogues.en: "I am Konomiya Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "I am Konomiya Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり。あの、有名な方ですね〜」
dialogues.en: "Just as I thought. You're famous here~"
dialogues.text: "Just as I thought. You're famous here~"

dialogues.jp: 環は黙って下を向く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki silently lowered her head.
dialogues.text: Tamaki silently lowered her head.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「風紀委員の天枷美春といいます。よろしくで
　す」
dialogues.en:
"I'm Amakase Miharu, of the discplinary committee. Nice to
meet you!"
dialogues.text:
"I'm Amakase Miharu, of the discplinary committee. Nice to
meet you!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ちなみに風紀委員は、学校の秩序と平和を守
　るために日夜戦っているのです」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, the discplinary committee is the faction formed
to protect the order and safety of the school, day-by-day."
dialogues.text:
"By the way, the discplinary committee is the faction formed
to protect the order and safety of the school, day-by-day."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「その台詞は、特撮アニメの影響か？」
dialogues.en:
"...The way you phrase it, makes it sound like you've been
influenced by those superhero anime."
dialogues.text:
"...The way you phrase it, makes it sound like you've been
influenced by those superhero anime."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「違いますよ。常々、美春が思ってることに決
　まってるじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Nope! My ideas are entirely my own!"
dialogues.text: "Nope! My ideas are entirely my own!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん。そうだったのか。初耳だな」
dialogues.en: "Oh yes, I'm sure they are."
dialogues.text: "Oh yes, I'm sure they are."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「今日も美春は学校のしもべとなり、働くので
　すよ」
dialogues.en: "For today, I am once again a servant of the school!"
dialogues.text: "For today, I am once again a servant of the school!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「西に誰かが転んだら助け起こし、東に誰かが
　突き飛ばされたら手当てに行くのです」
dialogues.en:
"Whether trouble springs from the east, or hazards at the
west, I will rush to the scene of the crime!"
dialogues.text:
"Whether trouble springs from the east, or hazards at the
west, I will rush to the scene of the crime!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「では、美春はこれで失礼します。先輩も、そ
　の人に突き飛ばされないよう、気をつけてく
　ださいね」
dialogues.en:
"So, please excuse me. Senpai, if you wish to continue
associating with this guy, be careful as well!"
dialogues.text:
"So, please excuse me. Senpai, if you wish to continue
associating with this guy, be careful as well!"

dialogues.jp: と、美春は環の方を見る。
dialogues.en: Miharu turned to Tamaki as she talked.
dialogues.text: Miharu turned to Tamaki as she talked.

dialogues.jp: さらっと、とんでもねぇこと言いやがる。
dialogues.en: What an offensive thing to say...
dialogues.text: What an offensive thing to say...

dialogues.jp:
無邪気に発言しているだけに、かえって恐ろし
いが、めちゃくちゃ失礼である。
dialogues.en:
Knowing her though, she said it of pure innocence, not of
malice or anything.
dialogues.text:
Knowing her though, she said it of pure innocence, not of
malice or anything.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなこと、ねえよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't say it like that."
dialogues.text: "Don't say it like that."

dialogues.jp: 今日の夢を見たせいなのか。
dialogues.en: That dream I saw was affecting me lots.
dialogues.text: That dream I saw was affecting me lots.

dialogues.jp:
環の気持ちを考えると、俺だけでもかばってや
りたくなる。
dialogues.en: I was thinking a lot more about her feelings now.
dialogues.text: I was thinking a lot more about her feelings now.

dialogues.jp: 環は、そのままでいいんだよ。
dialogues.en: She should be fine with that...
dialogues.text: She should be fine with that...

dialogues.jp: 俺が環でも、多分、そうだっただろうから。
dialogues.en: The way we are now, anyway.
dialogues.text: The way we are now, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そうですね。……すいません」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yeah... I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yeah... I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: 美春も気づいたのか、急にしおらしくなる。
dialogues.en: Noticing her rudeness herself, she quickly changed her tune.
dialogues.text: Noticing her rudeness herself, she quickly changed her tune.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいんですよ。気にしないでください」
dialogues.en: "It is fine, do not worry about it."
dialogues.text: "It is fine, do not worry about it."

dialogues.jp: 環は、苦笑いをして言った。
dialogues.en: Tamaki smiled at her, wistfully.
dialogues.text: Tamaki smiled at her, wistfully.

dialogues.jp: 「さ、教室へ行くか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go to our classrooms."
dialogues.text: "Let's go to our classrooms."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい、朝倉先輩」
dialogues.en: "Right, Asakura-senpai."
dialogues.text: "Right, Asakura-senpai."

dialogues.jp:
結局、話すタイミングを失って、俺は環に例の
ことを｛たず／訊｝ねるのをやめた。
dialogues.en:
With the timing shattered to pieces, I refrained from
enquiring any further about Tamaki's powers.
dialogues.text:
With the timing shattered to pieces, I refrained from
enquiring any further about Tamaki's powers.

dialogues.jp: 俺は環と美春を促し、校舎へと向かった。
dialogues.en: Instead, the three of us walked quietly into school.
dialogues.text: Instead, the three of us walked quietly into school.

dialogues.jp: ◆環の夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tamaki's Childhood Days?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tamaki's Childhood Days?◆

dialogues.jp: 幼い頃の環の夢を見る。
dialogues.en: I saw a dream of Tamaki's childhood.
dialogues.text: I saw a dream of Tamaki's childhood.

dialogues.jp:
同級生にいじめられた環は、槙の木の下で泣い
ていると、木の上の男の子に声をかけられる。
dialogues.en:
She was bullied by her classmates, and cried under a tree. A
boy called out to her from the top of the tree...
dialogues.text:
She was bullied by her classmates, and cried under a tree. A
boy called out to her from the top of the tree...

dialogues.jp: 男の子は、環に栗饅頭をプレゼントする。
dialogues.en: The boy presented a chestnut manjuu to Tamaki as a present.
dialogues.text: The boy presented a chestnut manjuu to Tamaki as a present.

dialogues.jp: その男の子は、幼い頃の俺だった。
dialogues.en: No doubt, that boy was me when I was young.
dialogues.text: No doubt, that boy was me when I was young.

dialogues.jp: その時に、約束をしたらしい……。
dialogues.en: It seems we promised ourselves during that time...
dialogues.text: It seems we promised ourselves during that time...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、登校中の環に、そのことを｛たず／訊｝ねようと思っ
たが、美春の乱入により、タイミングを失って
しまった。
dialogues.en:
On the way to school with Tamaki, I tried to ask about it,
but the interefering Miharu threw the timing off.
dialogues.text:
On the way to school with Tamaki, I tried to ask about it,
but the interefering Miharu threw the timing off.
